{{Top|leg}}
'''Shadow Base''' was a mobile facility used by [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Cronal]] in his guise as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Shadowspawn and his breakaway [[Legions of Shadow|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] located on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] and used by. Sited inside a volcano and capable of launching [[gravity bomb]]s, the base could be launched into space by the use of gravitic charges. In the course of Cronal's plan to capture [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and destroy the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force sent to end Shadowspawn campaign, Cronal then launched the base into space, where it broke apart and was destroyed.
